panel.summary: `*` and `+` empty bullets now interrupt paragraphs, a deviation beyond the documented `-` fix
panel.evidence:
`isEmptyBulletLine` accepts `-`, `*` and `+` (line 39), and `wrappedList` returns true for any of them when silently probed from a paragraph. But only `-` has the lheading/setext ambiguity the change exists to fix. Consequence: `foo\n*` previously rendered as paragraph text (`foo
*` under `breaks: true`) and now renders `

foo

`, silently swallowing a literal asterisk line. Same for `foo\n+`. Neither the design doc (which speaks only of `-`) nor any test covers this.
